subject: op-spd
title: OP.SPD.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 255 (CMOA(II)-13). OP-SPD (option spread) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RT-DY (reality dynamics) and PART (participation). From RT-DY: C-CONT (composite continuance). From PART: INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality). From C-CONT: INT (intention) and ATT (attitude). From INDIV-DY-RT: AF-NT (affinity nature). From AF-NT: PRI-INFO (principle information).
